objective: Build a model-agnostic C++/CUDA temporal controller with device-resident trial decisions, exact event boundaries, rollback and state accounting; use the current full-CNS CUDA trial graph only as the first pluggable model. Python may prepare the model but must not decide each microtrial.

observed_problem.controller_current: graph_control_v2.cpp synchronizes the host after each adaptive trial

independent_rivals.A: Coupled multirate waveform with exact dated events and recurrent correction; needs a partitioned model provider
independent_rivals.B: Spatial model partition and QSS/CSC with conservative influence bounds; unproven separation
independent_rivals.F: Exact adaptive device-resident control for the existing complete target/rate graph, then native model/body owners behind generic interfaces

first_prototype: An isolated CUDA 12.0 shared library accepts a captured graph source and device state/status buffers, uses device tail self-launch for an adaptive event-bounded epoch, and returns a compact result once per epoch. It must not alter production sources. A tiny graph checks API compatibility only; then at most one 1-ms sham real-organism candidate replay may run from the same settled checkpoint as a strict reference. No speed claim from the tiny graph.
science_contract: Same model equations, FP64 state, SET/ADD event times and ordering, target/rate evaluation, error norm, acceptance/rejection, domain checks, rollback and complete state. Compare state, RNG, events, model outputs and body against the original on real 1-ms replay; log any changed adaptive schedule explicitly. Hashes identify sources, not numerical equality of binaries.
early_falsators: CUDA 12.0 cannot instantiate the existing captured trial graph for device launch
tail self-launch cannot preserve adaptive event handling and rollback
the full-state or event trace differs outside the frozen tolerance
wall time including all owner boundaries does not materially improve over paired reference
interpretation: Success of the first prototype is a native control component, not a complete Python-free organism, biological equivalence, stage4/5 admission, or a 5-second speed claim.
